save_delayed_memory.description: Allows the model to save a delayed memory report.
rules: Use this marker after the user explicitly asks to create/save a delayed memory report, or when PROJECT_REVIEW is active and saving findings would help continue the project review.

lt_facts_ids contains exact existing committed L-T fact IDs (F<number>) that this report absorbs/represents. These IDs already exist before the report is created; populate them explicitly when collecting L-T facts into a report.
anchor_lt_facts_ids is the subset of lt_facts_ids that must remain globally visible as anchors after the report absorbs the other linked L-T facts.
Do not leave lt_facts_ids or anchor_lt_facts_ids empty merely because the report is new when the user explicitly asked to collect existing L-T facts into it.
